title: Gothic Cathedral Drama
description: Three women in elaborate gothic-punk attire pose dramatically in front of a large ornate cathedral with rose windows. A woman in a black velvet gown with red accents stands centrally holding a knife, a woman in a pink satin dress kneels on the stone ground reaching forward, while another woman in a pink blouse stands behind them with a distressed expression and hands on her head. Rose petals, broken crown pieces and debris are scattered across the foreground.
prompt: Three dramatic women in gothic fashion in front of a massive ornate cathedral with rose windows at dusk. A central woman in a black velvet gown with red trim and fishnets holds a dagger, a woman in a shiny pink satin dress with black corset kneels on the stone pavement, while another woman in a pink blouse stands behind them clutching her head with a distressed expression. Broken crown, scattered rose petals and debris on the ground, dark moody atmosphere, cinematic lighting
